evals.prompt: Create a mise task `skills` with subcommands auth, install, and uninstall. Follow kerpo conventions.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses nothing on the name `skills`, creates `.mise/tasks/skills` with #MISE/#USAGE cmd help, chmod +x, bats under tests/mise-tasks/skills.bats, pins or notes shellcheck/bats, does not create a task named install.

evals.prompt: Add a mise task named install that packs our apm skills.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses the name install as CLI-shadowing, proposes a domain task (e.g. skills) with an install subcommand instead, and scaffolds that shape if the user agrees.

evals.prompt: Add a one-liner mise.toml task that only runs `npm test`.
evals.expected_output: Agent keeps it in mise.toml as a one-liner with description and minimal usage for --help; does not force a file task for a single command.
